repo_notes.content: CAL (Creevo Agent Library) is a Python library for building agentic AI applications. Core components include Agent, GeminiLLM, FullCompressionMemory, Tool, SubAgentTool, and MCPTool. The package is installed from GitHub: pip install git+https://github.com/Creevo-App/creevo-agent-library.git
CAL requires Python >= 3.10. This is because CAL uses the union type syntax (X | Y) for type hints, which was introduced in PEP 604 and requires Python 3.10+.

FullCompressionMemory is the memory system in CAL. It requires a summarizer_llm for LLM-based context compression and supports file-based archival via CompressionArchiver. Example: memory = FullCompressionMemory(summarizer_llm=summarizer_llm, max_tokens=50000)

Agent constructor signature: Agent(llm, system_prompt, max_calls, max_tokens, memory, agent_name, tools=None, logger=None). The memory parameter requires a Memory instance (typically FullCompressionMemory).
